scenarios.description: The contract uses the defined term "Oversight Committee," and Section 5.5 contains the definition that gives that term its meaning.
The contract uses "Oversight Committee," but its meaning is defined in Section 4.2 instead of Section 5.5.
The contract says "Oversight Committee" has the meaning in Section 5.5, but also says that if Section 5.5 is amended later, the term takes the amended meaning.

A later section assigns responsibility for interpreting "Oversight Committee" to a specific actor before Section 5.5 is finalized, but the text still states the term shall have the meaning defined in Section 5.5.
